method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, constructor-by-constructor replay of closed-term evaluation, direct calculation of the worked multiplication/addition term, verification of the coverage condition, and exact projected formula, macro, controlled-token, identifier and reference comparison. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Values of closed terms, covered structures, a numeral-rich arithmetic structure and a worked recursive term evaluation.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A term is closed when it contains no variables. A closed constant term has the element assigned to that constant as its value; a function term has the result of applying the interpreted function to the recursively obtained values of its argument terms. A structure is covered exactly when every domain element is the value of some closed term.
samples.checks: Variable-freeness, both recursive value clauses, argument order, domain quantification and the existential closed-term condition are retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The example names every natural number by a constant, interprets less-than, addition and multiplication in the usual way, and evaluates two times (three plus zero) by recursively replacing each term with its interpretation, obtaining six.
samples.checks: All named constants, ordered-pair membership and nonmembership examples, function examples, prefix/infix forms and six displayed evaluation steps agree. OLFOL-011 removes only the source's duplicated display equality sign.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The exercise asks whether the standard model of arithmetic is covered and requests an explanation.
samples.checks: The question retains both the named structure and the coverage property rather than supplying the answer.

source_observations: OLFOL-011 records and projects the duplicate equality sign at the first line break of the frozen evaluation display.
The example supplies a constant for each natural number, which is the evidence relevant to the final coverage exercise.
All other formulas, macros, controlled tokens, identifiers and references match exactly.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The exact Marathi covered-structure phrase remains explicitly open to specialist review in T196.
